caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of fabric with a scalloped border on three sides, rendered in shades of gray. The fabric is decorated with ornate embroidered patterns featuring floral and leafy motifs, including flowers, leaves, and branching stems organized in a symmetrical design. A basket-like shape appears near the lower center with stems and leaves radiating from it. The embroidered patterns cover much of the visible surface, and the scalloped edge has additional patterned detailing. The background of the drawing is plain, with the fabric swatch placed centrally on the page. There is a small text at the bottom right that reads: "BRODERIE D'UTRECHT. XVIIIe SIECLE."
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
